skills.name: astack
skills.title: astack
skills.summary: Own a product task up to a proven, review-ready PR
skills.example: astack this: add annual pricing with tests, mobile checks and tracking.

skills.name: oneshot
skills.title: oneshot
skills.summary: Idea to merged, deployed, verified live and announced
skills.example: oneshot this: add annual pricing and take it all the way to production.

skills.name: context
skills.title: Context
skills.summary: Gather and reconcile what changes the task
skills.example: Read the Slack thread, the issue and the analytics before we touch checkout.

skills.name: web-design
skills.title: Web design
skills.summary: Design UI and motion that look like this product, not AI
skills.example: This page looks AI-generated. Give it a real direction and check mobile and dark.

skills.name: web-graphics
skills.title: Web graphics
skills.summary: Build bespoke isometric, flat and ASCII graphics
skills.example: Make an isometric hero showing three inboxes merging into one queue.

skills.name: deslop
skills.title: Deslop
skills.summary: Strip AI tells from copy, UI and code
skills.example: Deslop the landing page copy and components, keep the facts and voice.

skills.name: instrument
skills.title: Instrument
skills.summary: Track the outcome and prove the event arrives
skills.example: Track first listing published and give me a funnel I can trust.

skills.name: discoverability
skills.title: Discoverability
skills.summary: Fix why search and AI answers miss the product
skills.example: Audit why ChatGPT and Google don't surface us for 'best invoicing app for freelancers'.

skills.name: dogfood
skills.title: Dogfood
skills.summary: Use the product for real, fix what breaks
skills.example: Dogfood onboarding on my signed-in account on mobile and fix what you hit.

skills.name: ship
skills.title: Ship
skills.summary: Get to green, merge, deploy and prove it is live
skills.example: Ship this: clear the review threads and CI, deploy, verify production.

skills.name: launch
skills.title: Launch
skills.summary: Ready the page, kit, posts and tracker for launch
skills.example: Prepare the launch: share card, page audit, posts, directories and tracking.
